title: Mexican Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Colorful bell pepper halves stuffed with seasoned ground turkey, black beans, corn, rice, and salsa, topped with melted Mexican cheese.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Rinse the black beans and thaw the corn.
In a large bowl, combine the ground turkey, cooked rice, thawed corn, black beans, salsa, taco seasoning, and 1 cup of the Mexican cheese.
Cut the bell peppers in half lengthwise, removing the seeds and membranes. Place the halves in a baking dish.
Spoon the turkey and rice mixture into each pepper half.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove from the oven and sprinkle the remaining 1 cup of Mexican cheese over the tops.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve hot.
